source_record: **Purpose:** What is the capstone? **Answer:** An educational integrated financial mathematics toolkit built incrementally.
review: Educational integration purpose;not real-world suitability acceptance.

source_record: **Status:** Are all listed modules implemented here? **Answer:** No; only the one-period architectural slice is provided.
review: Source provides only two executable fences/one-period slice;proposed toolkit modules not installed or validated.

source_record: **Layers:** What precedes calculation? **Answer:** Validation and any documented normalization.
review: Actual evaluate validates before public calculation;input boundary exercised.

source_record: **Presentation:** Should a plotting layer define financial formulas? **Answer:** No; use calculation results and clearly label transformations.
review: Design separation only;no plotting implementation executed.

source_record: **Dependency:** May a bond module use a cash-flow function? **Answer:** Yes, through a documented contract.
review: Documented dependency proposal;no bond/cash-flow integration claimed.

source_record: **Direction:** Should cash-flow valuation require a plotting package? **Answer:** No; keep presentation outside the calculation core.
review: No plotting dependency in source;architecture policy not full-toolkit graph verification.

source_record: **Known value:** PV of 110 in one period at 10%? **Answer:** 100 in exact arithmetic.
review: 110/(11/10)=100 independent monetary benchmark and source checks.

source_record: **Zero rate:** PV of 110 at zero? **Answer:** 110.
review: At0 denominator1 returns110 source checked.

source_record: **Negative rate:** PV of 95 at −5%? **Answer:** 100 in exact arithmetic.
review: 95/(19/20)=100 independent benchmark and source checks.

source_record: **Boundary:** Why reject rate −1? **Answer:** Its denominator is zero.
review: Rate-1 rejected at evaluate and direct calculation boundaries.

source_record: **Rate units:** Is 10.0 equivalent to 10%? **Answer:** No; 10% is 0.10.
review: 10.0 produces100/11 for payment100,not100/(1+.1);both source cases checked.

source_record: **Period:** Can an annual rate be applied unconverted to a monthly payment? **Answer:** Not under this contract; periods must match.
review: Financial period alignment is caller contract,not runtime metadata validation.

source_record: **Signs:** Can a payment be negative? **Answer:** Yes; document the perspective.
review: Negative payment allowed;source negative100 and110 examples checked.

source_record: **Currency:** Does `USD` convert the amount? **Answer:** No; it is a label only.
review: Label preserved exactly;no FX operation or conversion implemented.

source_record: **Code:** Does the example verify ISO currency codes? **Answer:** No; it checks only a nonblank string.
review: Nonblank non-ISO XYZ label accepted as documented;blank/nonstring rejected.

source_record: **Rounding:** Is the internal result rounded to cents? **Answer:** No; display formatting is separate.
review: Amount unrounded float;reused main display two decimals is presentation,not currency rounding policy.

source_record: **Overflow:** Can finite inputs create infinity? **Answer:** Yes; the slice rejects a nonfinite result.
review: 1e308 at-.5 raisesValueError through evaluate;documented range limit retained.

source_record: **Underflow:** Does a finite result guarantee accuracy? **Answer:** No; underflow and rounding can occur.
review: Half-smallest-subnormal source result0 versus nonzero rational expectation documented;no defect invented.

source_record: **Type:** Is an integer payment accepted by the slice? **Answer:** No; it requires a built-in float.
review: Integer payment rejected;strict built-in float contract checked.

source_record: **Boolean:** Is `True` a valid rate? **Answer:** No, despite Boolean being an integer subtype in Python.
review: Boolean payment/rate rejected;optimized suite preserves explicit validation.

source_record: **Result:** Why keep the rate alongside the amount? **Answer:** To make the result interpretable and support traceability.
review: Result metadata checked against exact input/convention/model tuple.

source_record: **Provenance:** Does an in-memory result constitute an audit trail? **Answer:** No; durable, controlled evidence needs additional design.
review: Conceptual distinction:in-memory result lacks persistence/access/change controls;not audit acceptance.

source_record: **Immutability:** What does a frozen dataclass prevent? **Answer:** Normal reassignment of its fields.

source_record: **Error:** Why raise an exception for invalid input? **Answer:** To distinguish failure from a valid numerical result.
review: ValueError distinguished from validzero;exceptions reach caller/testboundary.

source_record: **Tolerance:** Why give a tolerance units? **Answer:** An amount tolerance differs from a rate tolerance.
review: Monetary tolerance units specified;no rate/business materiality threshold inferred.

source_record: **Benchmark:** Why independently derive 110/1.1? **Answer:** To reduce the risk of reproducing a code defect in the expected value.

source_record: **Monotonicity:** Does positive-payment PV fall as the rate rises? **Answer:** Yes, for this one-period model above −1.
review: Positive payment decreasing PV direction source checked.

source_record: **Mixed signs:** Must a mixed-sign cash-flow NPV always fall as rate rises? **Answer:** No.
